root_idea.summary: The root primarily concerns blame, censure, and reproach; a distinct classical branch concerns lingering or tarrying.
root_idea.development: The censure branch develops into active reproach, blame incurred or deserved, and reciprocal or self-directed blame. A separate lexical branch is recorded for التلوّم meaning lingering or delaying.

senses.definition: To blame, censure, or reprehend a person for something.
senses.usage_conditions: The person blamed may be followed by عَلَى for the matter occasioning the blame; the Qur'anic forms include direct reproach and a command to blame.

senses.definition: To blame or reproach one another.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction in which the parties direct blame at each other.

senses.definition: A blamer; one who censures or reproaches.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle of لام; in the construction لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ, it denotes the person who directs the blame.

senses.definition: Blame, censure, or reproach directed at someone.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ, it denotes the blame itself, in contrast with the لَائِم who directs it.

senses.definition: Self-reproaching; reproaching its possessor for wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: A Qur'anic epithet of the soul in النَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ. Classical explanation varies: it may denote a soul that reproaches itself after wrongdoing, or one settled in itself and prepared to admonish others.
A passive/resultative participle denoting one upon whom blame falls; Qur'anic contexts may expressly state that someone is not blameworthy.

senses.definition: Deserving blame; blameworthy because of an act.
senses.usage_conditions: Form IV active participle, emphasizing that the person has done something making him liable to blame, rather than merely being the recipient of an expressed reproach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who habitually blames other people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional personal noun for one characterized by blaming people.
A conventional personal noun for one who is the object of others' blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake or affect the act of blaming.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V; the expression indicates taking on or deliberately engaging in blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or act for which its doer is blamed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun referring to the blameworthy matter itself, not to the person who blames.
A distinct classical branch of التلوّم, separate from the branch involving blame.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I blame and reproach branch.
Form V undertaking or affecting blame.
The thing or act for which its doer is blamed.

cautions: مَلُوم denotes one blamed or held blameworthy, whereas مُلِيم denotes one deserving blame because of an act.

The core self-reproach meaning of لَوَّامَة is Qur'an-attested, but classical interpretation differs on the soul's rank and whether its admonition is directed primarily toward itself or toward others.
